operations.body: Added to 0.6.3 on 2026-11-21: the review of "Run the board behind a sign-in proxy" (PR #215) reproduced this on main (174 of 4000 requests from 16 threads answered 500, page loads as well as creates) and noted that hosting makes it reachable by every signed-in person. The hosted log also tells the operator to run workbook rebuild, which is the wrong advice for a passing race.
